title: Small talk with a colleague
objectives: Ask and answer simple questions about the weekend

courseTemplate.setting: An office kitchen on Monday morning. Two colleagues have a few minutes before their next meeting.

roles.learner: A colleague starting a friendly conversation
roles.partner: A friendly colleague who went hiking over the weekend

targetPatterns.example: That sounds fun! Where did you go?
Anyway, I need to get to my meeting. Catch up later!

stages.title: Start the conversation
stages.instruction: Greet the learner, then pause to let them start small talk rather than doing all the talking.
successCriteria: The learner responds to the greeting.
The learner starts a topic with a natural opening question.
hints: You could ask: How have you been?

stages.title: Exchange weekend news
stages.instruction: Mention the hike and invite a follow-up question. Ask about the learner’s weekend too.
successCriteria: The learner asks a relevant question about the weekend.
The learner shares an activity from their own weekend and responds to the partner.
hints: Share one activity, then ask a follow-up question.

stages.title: Close politely
stages.instruction: Mention the upcoming meeting and let the learner find a polite way to end the conversation.
successCriteria: The learner signals that the conversation is ending.
The learner uses a friendly closing or suggests catching up later.
hints: Try: Anyway, I need to get going.
